title: Tomb of the Birds and the wooden bird found during WWII
place_text: Northern cliff west of Great Pyramid, Giza

tellings.quote: uh there's this tomb called the tombs of the birds.

plain: On a northern cliff west of the Great Pyramid at Giza there is a burial site called the Tomb of the Birds, and the story attached to it is that a carved wooden bird was found there during the Second World War, in the 1940s. A researcher named Luke Caverns brings it up on the show without naming a source, and he mentions the television science show Mythbusters while telling it.
